column1: # Measured tests of the auth race-integration split packages of ci/auth_race_integration_splits.tsv (CHAOS-13693):
# package<TAB>TestName<TAB>seconds. An auth race-integration leg (check_go.sh auth race-integration-leg) cuts a split package's
# `go test -race -tags=integration -list` names into its parts by these rows (ci/go_race_shard.awk cut(), as
# ci/go_test_split_weights.tsv for the test legs): a measured name longest first onto the lightest part, any other name by a hash of
# its own name, so adding or removing an unmeasured test moves no other test. The auth plan does not read the rows for weights: a
# part weighs ceil(W / parts) as before (W = the package row of ci/auth_race_integration_weights.tsv).
# PROXY source: no CI run uploads per-test timings of this leg's own build (-race -tags=integration). seconds = round(W * m / M):
# m = the test's median top-level elapsed over the runs of its source, M = the sum of m over the listed tests. Tests without the
# integration tag: the go-test-timings-race-K-of-6 artifacts (go-quality.yml, -race) of go-quality push runs 43376042584,
# 43377857475, 43379257796, 43443132054. Tests with it: the go-test-timings-integration-packages-K artifacts (go.yml, push to main,
# -tags=integration WITHOUT -race) of runs 43471482033, 43473339069, 43473453879, 43474378490. -race slows CPU-heavy tests more than
# database-bound ones, so the integration rows can be low: a wrong value costs balance only, never a test.
# Rows: every listed test of 2 s or more, and the package's heaviest tests up to its part count (no part can be empty).
# A row must name a test `go test -race -tags=integration -list` reports: renaming or removing a measured test needs its row edited
# in the same change (the auth race-integration leg and internal/cigates/testshard fail otherwise). Refresh: the same reduction
# over newer runs; values only cost balance. Sorted (LC_ALL=C) by package, then test.
